basis: Inborn amine/neurotransmitter metabolic disorders; neurologic dysfunction affects most patients across the group (>30%).
Intellectual disability and hypogonadism define syndrome; skeletal deformity/bone loss and severe hearing loss each 80-99%; ocular anomalies omitted under cap.
Congenital cortical malformation; clubfoot in 2/6 (~33%) supports musculoskeletal involvement. Cataract 2/8 (25%) excluded.
Defining omphalocele with herniated abdominal viscera, diaphragmatic defect and radial skeletal defects; pulmonary damage frequency unspecified.
Corticospinal degeneration and peripheral neuropathy; lower-limb amyotrophy in 30-79%. Urinary urgency reflects neurologic dysfunction without established urinary tract damage.
Nonsyndromic sensorineural hearing loss, present in 17/17 reported patients.
Treponemal infection with chronic cutaneous lesions and atrophy; common destructive skeletal involvement is not established.
Defining skin/nail, upper-airway and conjunctival granulation disease; enamel hypoplasia 6/6 and oral mucosal blisters 30-79% support gastrointestinal involvement.
Primary epithelial malignancy of the rectosigmoid colon.
Lymphoid-cell malignancy arising in breast; lymphoma warrants haematologic and infectious_immune axes. Breast has no anatomical axis.
Inherited vitreoretinal degeneration with cataract, chorioretinal atrophy and retinal detachment; no defining extraocular disease.
Ischemic necrosis directly damages the pituitary endocrine gland; infarction alone does not establish a separate vascular disorder.
Abnormal recession of the globe within the orbit; defined ocular adnexal disorder.
Primary astrocytic CNS tumor involving cerebral cortex and leptomeninges.
Trauma-associated psychiatric anxiety disorder; no qualifying organ damage.
Retinal cone photoreceptor dysfunction causing impaired color discrimination and visual acuity.
Umbrella for extranodal lymphoid malignancies; lymphoma mechanism applies throughout, but no anatomical organ is shared across the group.
Axonal peripheral neuropathy; distal amyotrophy 3/3, lower-limb amyotrophy 2/2 and documented muscle fatty replacement support common muscle tissue loss.
Primary carcinoma of the uterine endometrium, a reproductive site outside the organ axes.
Chronic fungal infection of scalp skin and hair follicles causing crusting and scarring.
Inherited renal tubulointerstitial disease with fibrosis, tubular atrophy and kidney failure; secondary renal anemia does not establish direct blood disease.
Sarcoma arising in the ovary, a reproductive site; endocrine dysfunction or locomotor tissue involvement is not established.
Structural myocardial disorder with ventricular non-compaction and possible systolic dysfunction.
Partial gonadal dysgenesis affects testicular endocrine development; congenital heart disease is a named syndrome component, with tetralogy of Fallot in 1/3.
Inherited skeletal muscular dystrophy with limb-girdle weakness and early joint contractures; definition explicitly excludes cardiomyopathy.
